agent_name: Wagie — WagerX iGaming & Regulatory Intelligence Agent

claim_boundaries.discovery: A published manifest or listing is not an endpoint check.
claim_boundaries.handshake: A protocol handshake is not evidence retrieval.
claim_boundaries.reachability: An HTTP response is not a protocol handshake.
claim_boundaries.signature: A valid signature proves WagerX origin and payload integrity, not independent truth, safety, legality or continuous uptime.

stages.claim: Canonical manifest can be built and identifies Wagie.
Agent Card identity and tool inventory match the canonical manifest.
A2A metadata advertises both accepted protocol dialects.
limitations: This self-check does not prove uninterrupted external reachability.

stages.claim: MCP server identity and protocol version are configured.
limitations: This self-check is distinct from an external network handshake.

stages.claim: MCP tool inventory is available and contains both audit and regulatory tools.
A probe payload can be signed and verified by the active WagerX key.
limitations: Signature validity proves origin and integrity, not claim truth.

stages.claim: One covered casino can be projected into the normalized evidence schema.
One approved-source regulatory response can be projected into the normalized evidence schema.
limitations: A degraded result is explicit and never converted into an empty success claim.
